turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I’m your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: For the past few days, I’ve had intense itching on my right thigh, and then red bumps showed up in that same area. I also noticed itching on my left leg and right forearm with some scratch marks from excoriations.
[ASK] Do you have **itchy, greasy/scaly patches on the scalp or other oily areas** (e.g., eyebrows, sides of nose, behind ears)?

“No, I haven’t noticed any itchy, greasy, or scaly patches on my scalp or oily areas like my eyebrows, sides of the nose, or behind my ears. The itching and red bumps have been mainly on my right thigh, with some itching on my left leg and my right forearm.”
[ASK] Do you have well-demarcated, milky-white patches of skin that are clearly different from the surrounding skin (often with no scaling)?

Patient: No, I haven’t noticed well-demarcated milky-white patches with no scaling—mostly it’s been red bumps and intense itching, with some scratch marks on my right thigh, and itching on my left leg and right forearm.
[ASK] Is the skin lesion(s) a scaly, “stuck-on” brown/black plaque that looks like it can be scraped off only with difficulty (typical seborrheic keratosis appearance)?

“No, I don’t have scaly, stuck-on brown or black plaques that look like they can be scraped off with difficulty. It’s been mainly intensely itchy red bumps, mostly on my right thigh, and some itching on my left leg and right forearm with scratch marks from excoriations.”
